question: Which customer region generated the most revenue? Revenue is product price times quantity, summed over order items.

sql: SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' ORDER BY table_name
SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'customers' ORDER BY ordinal_position
SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'order_items' ORDER BY ordinal_position
SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'orders' ORDER BY ordinal_position
SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'products' ORDER BY ordinal_position

SELECT c.region, SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY revenue DESC
SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status

SELECT c.region, SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'returned' GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY revenue DESC

answer:
The South region generated the most revenue, at 1,201,250.00 (price × quantity summed over all order items). West followed with 1,173,750.00, then North at 1,162,500.00 and East at 1,160,000.00.

South also leads if returned orders are excluded. In that case North drops out entirely, because all of its orders have status 'returned'. The remaining order: South 1,201,250.00, West 1,173,750.00, East 1,160,000.00.

question: Which product category has sold the most units in total?

sql: SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' ORDER BY table_name
SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'products' ORDER BY ordinal_position
SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'order_items' ORDER BY ordinal_position

SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_all, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status <> 'returned' THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS units_excl_returned FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY units_all DESC

answer: The "tools" category has sold the most units: 11,000 units in total across all orders. It stays on top when returned orders are excluded (8,250 units, ahead of food at 7,500).

question: In the 'games' category, which product has the highest revenue (price times quantity)? Give the product name.

sql: SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' ORDER BY table_name
SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'products' ORDER BY ordinal_position
SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'order_items' ORDER BY ordinal_position
SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'orders' ORDER BY ordinal_position

SELECT p.name, SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) AS revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status <> 'returned' THEN p.price * oi.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_excl_returned FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE p.category = 'games' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10

answer: product_81 is the top 'games' product by revenue, at 70,700 (price × quantity across all orders). If returned orders are excluded, the leader changes to product_86 (56,100).

question: Which customer region has the most orders with status 'returned'?

sql: SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' ORDER BY table_name

text: None of the cached queries counts returned orders by region, so I'll check the table structures and write a new query.

sql: SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'orders' ORDER BY ordinal_position
SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'customers' ORDER BY ordinal_position
SELECT c.region, COUNT(*) AS returned_orders FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'returned' GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY returned_orders DESC

answer: The north region has the most returned orders, with 1,250 orders with status 'returned'. It is the only region with any returned orders in the data.
